notes.text: The personal title is abbreviated and retained as R'; supposed Tannaitic-era context does not establish Rabbi. The locator קמז.. is conventionally rendered147a, with the doubled punctuation preserved in Hebrew; no named edition or explanation of the second period is verified. Kapposai remains the supplied name form.
